hooks.command: echo 'Axiom: call governance.preflight_change before designing or editing; stop on REQUIRE_REVIEW, DENY or error (see AGENTS.md).'

axiom-cli evaluate-diff --repository "$AXIOM_REPOSITORY" --base "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" --head "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --format text || { echo 'Axiom: diff validation did not pass; see output.' >&2; exit 2; }
